name: An employee earning 100,000 with private health insurance
workings: Above the 77,400 compulsory-insurance limit, so PKV: no statutory health or care contributions
Premium 600 a month, 7,200 a year; the employer pays half, within its maximum (508.59 + 104.63 a month): 3,600.00; the employee pays 3,600.00
Deductible basic cover: 80% × 7,200 − the employer's 3,600 = 2,160.00; the other 20% and unemployment would only count within 1,900, which the basic cover already uses
